title: FINRA Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) Exam
releaseBlockers: trademark review of the FINRA and SIE names
MSRB content is tier D (its terms forbid derivative works): MSRB concepts need SEC or Federal Register sources
FINRA's Terms of Use bar using finra.org with AI programs: no card may rest on a finra.org page, and FINRA rule facts need SEC or Federal Register sources
description: SIE: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
sourceShort: SEC regulations, federal law and FINRA's rules
notice: Securities Industry Essentials and SIE are registered trademarks of the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc. (FINRA). This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by FINRA.

checks.what: Three independent audits read all 1094 cards against the SEC, Federal Register, eCFR, US Code, investor.gov and other government texts they quote, word for word as found by the card checker; no card rests on FINRA's or the MSRB's own pages
checks.result: 6 wrong cards were fixed and rechecked, among them the 529 plan limit for school fees (raised to $20,000 from 2026, sourced to 26 U.S.C. 529) and the option expiry day (the third Friday since 2015, sourced to the SEC's 2013 order); 5 cards were re-sourced to a second government source; 18 unsupported claims, 6 ambiguous cards, 14 unclear ones and 137 minor issues (53 of them rules due to change, now marked volatile) were also fixed.
